_note: What you see: The setup wizard with a sample data card that loads itself.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De installatiewizard met een kaart voorbeeldgegevens die zichzelf laadt.
Voorbeeldgegevens vullen de lijsten, det: Sample data fills the lists, detail pages and dashboards, so you see the app working right away. Each card has its own button to load. None of this is required; you can close this window and come back later.
Geen, ik richt het zelf in: None, I'll set it up myself
Er wordt niets geladen. U begint met een: Nothing is loaded. You start with an empty app and add your own projects. Choose this on a production environment.
Drie voorbeeldprojecten met borden, fase: Three sample projects with boards, phases, tasks, dependencies, logged time, risks, status reports and portfolios. You become the owner and get the tasks assigned; the dates are around today. You can load this more often and remove it later.
Dezelfde kaart terwijl hij laadt, vlak n: The same card while it loads, right after a click on Load
